overview_text: The artificial intelligence and physics combined major brings together computer science, artificial intelligence, physics, and mathematics. From hands-on experience with sophisticated physics instruments, to mathematical theory, to the latest computational innovations, our interdisciplinary approach is designed to prepare students for the myriad challenges in today’s rapidly changing world.
